text: EDA leader forecasts $11.15bn revenue in FY27 as OpenAI, Amazon deals drive AI push Synopsys is the world's leading maker of chip design software. (Nikkei montage/Source photos from Synopsys' website) PALO ALTO, California -- Chip design software leader Synopsys is looking to help Chinese companies develop chips faster with an AI version of its tools by partnering with large language model (LLM) builders in China, saying it will work within Washington's tightening controls on AI and semiconductor exports.
